title: The Trail to Rainbow Ranch
moral: Kindness and helping others make journeys better.

scenes.summary: May begins her journey to Rainbow Ranch with a special box.
scenes.text: May rides her horse Button carrying a special box to Rainbow Ranch.
scenes.image_prompt: cowgirl riding horse across prairie with bag, colorful cartoon children's book style
scenes.story: Morning came on the wide prairie as cowgirl May prepared for a journey. She rode her horse Button carrying a wooden box for Little Jo at Rainbow Ranch. May traveled across the bright land with care and kindness. She reached a gate and carefully opened and closed it behind her. At a river she met a baker who helped her cross using stones and a rope. They shared food kindly. Along the trail she helped guide a small calf back safely to its herd. When strong wind came she waited patiently until it passed. Finally May reached Rainbow Ranch where Little Jo welcomed her warmly. May gave the wooden box which held a star pin and a message to be brave and kind. Everyone gathered happily sharing food and songs. May felt joyful knowing her journey helped others and spread kindness.
